Once per turn, when an opponent's monster declares an attack: You can make that opponent's monster lose 300 ATK for each face-up Pendulum Monster in your Extra Deck.

If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can send 1 "Performapal" or "Odd-Eyes" monster from your Deck to the GY, except "Performapal Odd-Eyes Valet", and if you do, this card's Level becomes the same as that monster's, until the end of this turn.
